title: Customers above their country average
statementMd:
Among customers with non-cancelled orders, list those whose total spend exceeds the average total spend of customers in their own country. Show name, country and total rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `name`, `country`, `total`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Build per-customer totals in a CTE and compare with a window average per country.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH s AS (SELECT c.id, c.name, c.country, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status <> 'cancelled' JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id) SELECT name, country, ROUND(total, 2) AS total FROM (SELECT *, AVG(total) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_avg FROM s) WHERE total > country_avg;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
